name: Tombstone
summary: Lonnie Lincoln is a nearly invulnerable mob enforcer in Spider-Man’s New York. He is a crime figure in the comics and a presence in The Spectacular Spider-Man, not a film lead in this archive.
powers: Superhuman strength and skin hardened to a chalky near-invulnerability.
origin: A Harlem criminal whose albino appearance and durability made him an enforcer.
